detailed_description: Loan Calculator is a comprehensive financial tool that helps you calculate loan payments, total interest, and view detailed amortization schedules. Whether you're planning a mortgage, car loan, or personal loan, this calculator provides accurate payment estimates based on your loan amount, interest rate, and term. Support for monthly, biweekly, and weekly payment frequencies helps you understand different repayment options.
usage_steps: Specify the loan term in months
View the calculated payment amount and total interest
Optionally view the full amortization schedule
usage_examples: Calculate monthly mortgage payments for a home purchase
Compare different loan terms to find the best option
View how much interest you'll pay over the life of the loan
